AUTH-08 operator-only Account/membership lifecycle serializes Account CAS, scoped terminal session/challenge invalidation and mandatory audit intent; no new schema or public seat/plan assignment. auth.entry.observed: AUTH-04 explicit HTTPS cookie entry: CSRF issuance or password proof + account membership. Signed host-only CSRF, rate/hash bounds, no password-only ADMIN session; safe 422/no-store. AUTH-05 named ADMIN password proof yields enrollment/login challenge only; no full session before MFA. AUTH-08 selects only active, unexpired Accounts and rechecks half-open Account expiry in session/MFA verification.
auth.entry.target: Preserve entry/challenge distinction; MFA AUTH-05, full proxy/UI AUTH-06, OIDC AUTH-19. No caller-supplied identity authority.

auth.session.observed: AUTH-04 opaque PostgreSQL session, online expiry/credential/subject/epoch/membership checks; self-only session/password commands; CSRF on mutation; audit intent atomic with state. AUTH-05 sessions require current MFA factor for ADMIN; MFA evidence only from confirmed local TOTP. AUTH-06 safe generated me DTO; optional account selection after password proof, no session for account choices. AUTH-08 enforces Account expiry and current entitlements; me exposes effective capabilities without role-derived upgrade.
auth.session.target: Effective Account entitlements/ownership, common proxy and named admin rollout remain AUTH-06/07/08/09/11/20.

auth.mfa.entry.observed: AUTH-05 CSRF+exact Origin; opaque purpose-bound PostgreSQL single-use challenge, 5m expiry, 5 attempts plus subject-wide limiter; current identity/credential/epoch/account membership checked; TOTP replay fence, recovery revokes all sessions; mandatory audit intent atomic. Challenge never authorizes protected API. Pending recovery login remains a recovery-only challenge; another unused code can resume a lost response; password alone cannot restart enrollment.
auth.mfa.entry.target: First-party proxy/login UX and named browser admin route rollout in AUTH-06/07; WebAuthn UV preferred future adapter; current local fallback TOTP.

auth.mfa.session.observed: AUTH-05 online AuthSession+CSRF+Origin; password+TOTP step-up proof scoped to exact session/action, single-use and 5m; replacement/recovery rotation consume proof atomically with mandatory audit. MFA-session password change also requires password.change proof. AUTH-08 enforces Account expiry and current entitlements; me exposes effective capabilities without role-derived upgrade.
auth.mfa.session.target: Extend action catalogue only alongside guarded sensitive admin APIs in AUTH-07; no client MFA assertions.

auth.ops.observed: AUTH-20: обязательный audit outbox получает периодическую bounded-доставку (ops sweeper, required-режим); terminal security transitions (revoked/consumed/settled/applied) capture'ятся в append-only auth_ops_ledger триггерами 0032; ops-CLI export/reconcile/quarantine/lockdown не добавляет HTTP-маршрутов.
auth.ops.target: Mandatory fault не оставляет неучтённое изменение: intent в outbox в одной транзакции с мутацией, доставка идемпотентна (audit_id fence), refusal memory-sink 503. Restore из backup не воскрешает revoked credential/consumed admission/settled reservation: marks файл вне pgdata + reconcile re-apply (over-charge невозможен, under-charge в отчёте). Safe rollback -- env CISSTAT_AUTH_LOCKDOWN закрывает 4 входа (503 auth_lockdown), не трогая сессии/ключи/internal-guards; quarantine закрывает сессии и кампании до reconciliation. DDL-отката нет.

billing.wallet.observed: AUTH-24 wallet READ surface: an active member of the current personal identity reads a usage projection of the AUTH-21 wallet (totals, reserved, next expiry, server-computed can_purchase_cu/can_spend_cu and lifecycle reasons); the OWNER additionally receives the per-source breakdown and the locked_reason; the ledger endpoint is OWNER-only and carries the bounded financial journal with money documents.
billing.wallet.target: Financial privacy: money, per-source breakdown and history never reach MEMBER; the ledger never answers to non-owners; read over an expired subscription preserves the balance and reports spending_blocked_reason instead of pretending a spendable state; admission to spending stays with the AUTH-12 coordinator.

billing.topup.observed: AUTH-22 top-up checkout: operator-provisioned immutable package catalog, server-side quote snapshot (no client price/units), durable order saga with provider GET-confirmed proof, bounded untrusted inbox wake-up on the existing webhook, atomic order transition + purchased lot + mandatory audit in one transaction.
billing.topup.target: Only a confirmed server payment credits CU: duplicate events, browser return, callback spoof, currency/amount tamper and out-of-order events cannot credit or uncredit a top-up; paid_review keeps captured money visible for the audited operator resolution; AUTH-23 refunds move held CU only after a provider-confirmed refund proof.

billing.refund.observed: AUTH-23 refund/dispute workflow: OWNER full refund of a credited whole unused purchased lot (windowed, unique per order, saga with lease/fence/backoff and independent GET-confirmed proof); unknown provider outcomes keep the refund_pending hold; trusted dispute opening locks the wallet, holds the remaining available and records spent exposure in auth_disputes; resolution is single and audited (lost extinguishes held CU, won unlocks them back).
billing.refund.target: Spend/refund race stays exclusive (reserved/spent/held lots cannot be refunded or disputed-hidden); an unknown result never unlocks the hold; a spent chargeback becomes recorded exposure, never a negative available balance; recovery after a lost dispute is an explicit audited wallet procedure (AUTH-24/25).
